meta.name: Latch — wire the protocol fee controller, at zero
meta.description: Sets the controller's default fee to 0 BEFORE pointing either pool manager at it, then points both. Wiring alone is not neutral: LatchProtocolFeeController's constructor arms _defaultFee at DEFAULT_FEE_PIPS = 1000 (0.1%) in both directions, verified on chain as defaultFee() == (true, 1000, 1000). Pointing a manager at it without zeroing first would start charging 0.1% on every pool initialized afterwards, which contradicts the launch-at-0 position in CLAUDE.md. Order is load-bearing and the batch is atomic, so no pool can initialize in a window where the default is still armed.
